title: Read current memory list heads without replaying every displayed revision
outcome: Memory list pages read current head projections and stored revision metadata rather than every canonical version and assertion belonging to each displayed key.
acceptance: An unfiltered or filtered memory list page reads only the selected keys' current projections and their stored revision metadata, not their complete canonical histories
Revision numbers, active state, retirement metadata and first-line rendering remain identical, including restored tombstones
A many-revision regression measures work proportional to the page size rather than total displayed history
